title: induced-gravity-count: the Standard Model's induced Newton constant, counted exactly
description: The sign of the Standard Model's induced Newton constant as an exact count over species, with its conditions stated: each species' kinetic part and curvature insertion, the criterion for the sign, the floor on generations, the bound on the Higgs doublet's curvature coupling, and the cost of a further gauge boson if gravity is induced. Every number in the accompanying paper is generated by this repository, and the counts and the identities they rest on are machine-checked in Lean 4 against a second implementation in Python.
